todoist.description: Handle your Todoist tasks and projects.

login.description: 🎉 Log in to your Todoist account.
login.alreadyLoggedIn: {{x}} You are already logged in to your Todoist account. Use {{helpCommand}} to learn how to use Tickly.
login.existingPendingSession:
{{i}} You already started a login session but haven't completed it yet.
A new authentication link will be sent in the next message, the previous one is now invalid.
login.instructions:
**Click the link below to log in.**
You will be redirected to a secure Todoist login page, where you'll be asked to authorize Tickly to access your account.

logout.description: ⛔ Log out from your Todoist account.
logout.noSession:
{{x}} You are not logged in to a Todoist account.
> Perhaps you wanted to log in? Use {{loginCommand}} to do so.
logout.logoutError: {{x}} An error occurred while logging out of your Todoist account. Please try again.
logout.logoutSuccess: {{v}} You have been logged out of your Todoist account successfully.
